edus.text: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari asked the Minister of Youth and Sports to state what steps forward will be implemented, following the results obtained in the 2023 SEA Games in Cambodia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, we have seen and heard a lot of news about the achievements of the national squad team in the last SEA Games, including positive and negative reports.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I would like to thank the Honorable Member for raising this question to enable this matter to be repeated in the Dewan Rakyat and recorded in Hansard.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This morning, together with us are a group of national athletes who have struggled to make the country famous at the last Cambodian SEA Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: These are gold, silver and bronze medal winners in Cambodia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, the 32nd SEA Games in Cambodia have involved the participation of the Malaysian contingent of 674 athletes and 312 officers including the secretariat and medical support team.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Officially, the Malaysian contingent managed to win 34 gold medals, 45 silver medals, which are eight additional medals and 96 bronzes, which are 32 additional medals exceeding the target and ranked seventh in total.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, the Malaysian contingent has set a target of 141 medals in total
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and managed to overcome the target
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: when it won 175 medals in total.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This time, the Malaysian contingent has participated in 41 percent of the total contested events
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and has set a target of 40 gold medals, 37 silver medals and 64 bronzes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We did not achieve it as gold medals, a lack of six.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Cambodia's host strategy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For your information, at this Games, the host country of Cambodia has decided not to compete in several events that are expected to give Malaysia the hope of 18 gold medals
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and introduce some of their country's traditional sports that offer 93 gold medals.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In addition, the host country has also listed many imported athletes in major sports events and changed some rules related to age.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: All of these things have narrowed Malaysia's chances of winning medals for the national contingent as a whole.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Taking into account the Cambodian strategy, part of Malaysia's initial determination to participate in the SEA Games this time is for us to provide wider exposure and opportunities for young and back-up athletes to compete for the first time in Cambodia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I ask for extra time
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because many of these issues are raised in the media Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Young athletes' achievements.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the information of Honorable Members, a total of 427 or 63 percent of those who compete this time are under 23 years old and 62 percent are athletes who first went to the SEA Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Of these, 12 gold medalists, 20 silver medalists and 46 bronze medalists are the first appearance athletes and two of them are only 15 years old. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
everyone

edus.text: Although young, some of them have broken their records.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I can't read everything.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the move forward, answer your honorable question.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: First of all, it is for Malaysia to focus on sports that have the potential to offer many medals.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The National Sports Association will be required to present a short-term and long-term planning plan to ensure that Malaysia can compete with Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam at the next SEA Games
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and also for the Asian Games and the Olympic Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Among the emphasis that will be given is that sports events that offer many medals such as swimming and athletics must bring change.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This emphasis will be given
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because they have many events to get medals.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We will also focus on martial arts and diving
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because both of these sports have brought home gold medals and their athletes excel.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: One of them sits here Enrique, our diver.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: National athletes such as Shereen, Umar Osman will also be given financial assistance
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and other athletes we are studying to ensure that they prepare for the Asian Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Both, are providing training infrastructure and facilities for sports events that have the potential to bring home medals such as obstacle race and indoor hockey, where they have successfully brought home silver and bronze medals even though there is no special facility for now in Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Imagine there are no facilities, they are able to bring back medals.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The third, is to optimize the matching grant method given by the Honorable Prime Minister in this budget, RM40 million for us to organize more tournaments for our athletes to improve their ranking.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Fourth, KPI setting.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The Ministry will work with the National Sports Association to prepare a post-mortem report.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: They are given two weeks from now for the short and long-term period
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and also winning factors will also be studied.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: `` 1010 KBS will also work with MOM, the National Sports Council, the National Sports Institute and the National Sports Association to set KPIs for the Thai SEA Games and this KPI will be monitored every four months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Fifth, it is for us to work with the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Higher Education to unearth new talents.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: We want with permission, cast a bigger net, a wider net to ensure that children after COVID-19, this COVID-19 pandemic, to have the opportunity to learn new sports
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and we can unearth their talents.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The sixth is that I yesterday conducted a post-mortem with athletes who have missed the gold medal to hear from athletes, not only from coaches or the National Sports Association, the challenges they face.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I believe with this open attitude, all these suggestions, we will implement to ensure that Malaysia has a brighter opportunity in the SEA Games in Thailand later.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Honorable Pasir Mas.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister for the answer that I think covers a lot of facts and data.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: I agree that the team led by the Honorable Minister has a short time to prepare for the SEA Games.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: However, I refer to the Honorable Minister's statement when it mentions that political instability is one of the causes of the achievement of the SEA Games.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: I think many people don't understand this statement.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: This is because if we look at it by mentioning some countries, Kenya, Cuba and Serbia, their politics are not more stable than us but from a sports point of view,
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: they are quite perform.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: That does not mention Palestine as a war country
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: but the football team, the ranking is higher than Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: So, the question is if the Honorable Minister mentions that political instability causes achievements in the sport to be affected, what does the Honorable Minister do for the future to ensure that whatever happens in politics does not affect sports
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: because this sport belongs to all?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]
addressees: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor, I have expected this question to arise.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: So, I am ready.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This is because every time I speak, I have a legal background
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and I make sure every time I speak, I have facts.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: That's why when I mention the political instability, I have- now, I have a chance to explain this issue.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The countries mentioned by Yang Berhormat, not those competing in the SEA Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I want to take an example, for us here yes.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For us here.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: High performance sports- ah, don't laugh.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This is because I will have facts here later to prove how our athletes' achievements are indeed interrupted.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Okay.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In the past four years, we have changed three Honorable Prime Ministers and three Honorable Ministers of Youth and Sports.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Since May 2013, the Honorable Minister of KBS at that time `` KJ '' had 61 months to prepare for sports.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In July 2018, the Honorable Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman had only 20 months to prepare before the Sheraton Step took place.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Then, Datuk Seri Reezal Merican Naina Merican for 18 months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: After that, Datuk Seri Ahmad Faizal Azumu's 'Peja' with 16 months' permission.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In four years, three Honorable Ministers exchanged and every time we changed,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: there was a change of board members, with permission, budget as well and focus.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I want to quote only one event, specifically for this.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In the details of the 2022 budget presented in October 2021, there is no mention of the allocation given for the Podium Program for 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This has caused the National Sports Council to reorganize the athletes' preparation program towards the main sports games for 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Among them, the Vietnam SEA Games, Commonwealth Games, Birmingham Games, ASEAN Games and for China, for this year ASEAN Games.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: As a result, a total of 220 athletes were unable to continue training since no specific allocation was given for the implementation of the Senior Training Program under the Podium Program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: At the same time, MSN had to distribute and use internal allocations to ensure that the Athletes Training Allowance and the coach's salary continued without delay to not affect the performance of the athletes who were in training.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This situation lasted for a period of two months from January to February 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: The Ministry took the initiative to apply to the Cabinet ...
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman [Bentong]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: ... To obtain the allocation of the Podium Program
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and it has been agreed under the 12th Malaysia Plan amounting to RM240 million from 2022 to 2025 which is RM60 million per year on 23 February 2022.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Dr. Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen [Bandar Kuching]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Every time we have changes like this,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: when there is a delayed allowance
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and the coach's salary is also delayed
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because this budget is not available.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Okay, this affects their training.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman [Muar]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: This is because there is something to go abroad
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: and I have a discussion with athletes and associations.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: It's true, they stated that in these four years,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: while we are busy here in politics and our neighboring countries have advanced forward.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For me to easily answer, I can just give all the burden of answers and reasons, I put it to the National Sports Association.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: However, I believe it is an irresponsible act
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: if I don't mention that the political situation in Malaysia has also played a role.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: One of the factors.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I'm not saying
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: it's all because of political instability.
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: However, we must certify in the last four years,
edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]
addressees: Tuan Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: after the Sheraton Step, there has been a lot of effort that the government has made at that time

edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.speaker: Menteri Belia dan Sukan [Puan Yeoh Tseow Suan]

edus.text: I invite the Honorable Mr. Lo Su Fui, Tawau.

edus.text: Tuan Lo Su Fui asked the Prime Minister to state what the Federal Government's commitment is to help resolve the water supply issue in Sabah as stated in the recent National Convention of the Unity Government including the approach of taking over water management in Sabah as reported by certain media which is feared to be against the spirit of the Malaysia Agreement 1963 ( MA63 ) and what is the role of the Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Division ( BHESS ), JPM in ensuring that this commitment is implemented.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Tawau.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, I take this opportunity to welcome the presence and congratulate our national heroes who have succeeded in the last SEA Games, who are present with us today.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the answer to the first component in the question earlier is no -
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: because water is one of the jurisdictions of the state List II, Ninth Schedule of the Federal Constitution.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: So Yang Berhormat Tawau does not need to worry that the Federal Government under the leadership of Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun will always respect the rights and interests
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and also the rights of the state, including additional jurisdictions to Sabah and Sarawak as contained in the List IIA, Ninth Schedule of the Federal Constitution.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: The second component, related to BHESS's role in this issue, the Sabah Sarawak Affairs Division ( BHESS ) does not have a direct role.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: First because this water-related issue is not an issue that arises in delayed issues, in the MA63 consultation platform.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Secondly, the water issue is also closely related to the Ministerial Functions Act, especially the Ministry of Finance
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and also the Ministry of Natural Resources ( NREC )
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: The Honorable Minister is here
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and it is understood that negotiations have already started as soon as the commitment of the Prime Minister's government, the Honorable Minister NREC has already held consultations with the Kelantan and Sabah governments as well as the state government is submitting, finalizing their wishlist to be submitted to the Honorable Prime Minister
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and also the responsible ministries.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: So God willing,
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: the Federal Government will not interfere with the rights and jurisdiction of the Sabah Sarawak state government as in the List of IIA, Ninth Schedule of the Federal Constitution, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Honorable Tawau.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: First, yesterday in this House
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: I raised the issue of electricity disruption in Sabah and water supply disruption
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: is also a big issue and the Honorable Prime Minister himself admitted that these two issues are very serious.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: The Honorable Minister mentioned earlier that the Sabah and Sarawak Division ( BHESS ) are not involved in dealing with these issues.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: So does the Honorable Minister see the need to create a special ministry of Sabah and Sarawak Affairs to ensure that the Federal Government can ensure that efforts to resolve delayed issues involving Sabah and Sarawak can be resolved.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Second, apart from the decrease in power to implement the RM50 million project and below to the state agency that the Prime Minister has announced, are there other things that are being planned to be involved in the process of disrepairing power to the Sabah and Sarawak State Governments?
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]
addressees: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah
Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]

edus.text: Thank you, Your Honor, the first question, the first component that I also think is being raised by Yang Berhormat Tuaran.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: First, we need to look at the objectives and mandate of the establishment of BHESS itself
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: which was established in March 2020.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: The mandate of the establishment of BHESS is to manage as a secretariat of issues arising in relation to MA63.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: That is the mandate of its establishment.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Second, we need to also look at the matters of the Minister's acts and functions orders.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: The issues arising in MA63 are also finally followed and the responsibility rests with the specific ministries involved in MOF, the Ministry of Public Works and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: For me, there is no need for overlap to the jurisdiction.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Let BHESS function as a secretariat for us to follow negotiations between the Federal Government of Sabah and Sarawak without having to interfere with the functions of the Minister in each ministry.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Third, we also need to look Mr. Speaker at the spirit of the MA63 principle.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: I think it is for us to give more empowerment to the state.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Likewise the devolution of authority of power to the governments of Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: So, so far I think we need to uphold the commitment of empowerment and devolution of authority without having to establish a specific ministry responsible for Sabah and Sarawak which may not only cause overlap with the ministries at the federal level
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: but also affect our efforts
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: to give empowerment and devolution of authority to the governments of Sabah and Sarawak.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: The next question is
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: if Yang Berhormat has proposals other than related to the RM50 million, there are matters like the governments of Sabah and Sarawak that we need to see to lower the power again to the states.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: We hope we will organize it in our platform.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: It is important that we expect the high commitment of Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun not only to be moved by him himself
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: but to be supported by all Members of the Cabinet
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and also the implementing and policy makers at the federal level to ensure that we can uphold the spirit
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: and also the commitment that has started by the pioneers of the struggle that established this homeland.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri (Hal Ehwal Sabah, Sarawak dan Tugas-tugas Khas) [Datuk Armizan bin Mohd Ali]
addressees: Tuan Lo Su Fui [Tawau]

edus.text: Mr. Khoo Poay Tiong asked the Minister of Natural Resources, Environment and Climate Change to state
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: how much subsidy expenditure the government has saved following the adjustment of Imbalance Cost Past-Through ( ICPT ) in January 2023,
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and what other measures are being planned by the government to rationalize electricity subsidies in Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: thank you Honorable City of Melaka.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: As we know, electricity tariffs are reviewed every six months with the Imbalance Cost Past-Through ( ICPT ) mechanism taking into account fuel costs and other generation costs for the last six months.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In this regard, the cost of ICPT for the period from July to December 2022 is as much as RM16.16 billion equivalent to the 20 sen kilowatt hour surcharge rate that should be released to all users for the period from January to June this year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: However, the government has agreed to maintain a two sen kilowatt hour rebate to all domestic users
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and maintain a 3.7 sen kilowatt hour surcharge to non-domestic users in the low voltage category, low voltage definition B and D as well as the specific question category which is H, H1 and H2 for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: While other non-domestic users are subject to surcharges at a rate of 20 sen kilowatt hours for the same period.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In this regard, the government has covered an electricity bill subsidy of RM10.76 billion for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023 to ensure that a total of 9.5 million electricity users representing 99 percent of the total users in Peninsular Malaysia will not be affected by the increase in fuel costs for electricity generation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This means that the government has made a subsidy savings of RM5.4 billion for the period from January 1 to June 30, 2023 where the cost has been released to consumers on a targeted basis.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Although non-domestic users in the medium and high voltage category are subject to an increase of 20 sen ICPT surcharge, the government still covers a subsidy of RM1.93 billion or a seven sen kilowatt hour surcharge
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: so that the actual increase is not released as a whole to the users involved.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For now, the ministry is still examining ICPT surcharge relief options that are reasonable to electricity users in the Peninsula for the period from July 1 to December 31, 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is in line with the government's focus so that subsidies are implemented on a targeted basis based on the amount of electricity consumption according to residence for domestic category users, especially those who use electricity at a high rate.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In addition, the government will also ensure that appropriate surcharges are charged to PMKS, agricultural definition categories users and water operators
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: so that the index of consumer prices and inflation in the country is in a controlled situation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have a bottom line to ensure that before the national development model is low-cost development or low-cost economy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We want to be a high-value economy
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we also want to achieve energy efficiency and a transition to renewable energy and only with us really pass-through the cost to high and medium voltage users and large users or T20,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: we can achieve that objective.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: A decision for the next ICPT will be made after the presentation and agreement at the Cabinet level in the near future.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Minister, when the government announces a policy to abolish electricity subsidies for T20, out there the average society has confusion.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: They think everything will be abolished including B40 and M40, they think the electricity tariff has gone up.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Perhaps the Minister can take the opportunity here to explain what the details are for abolishing T20 so that the affected T20 groups know, can adapt and those who are B40 and M40 will not misunderstand.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: That's the first.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Second, we can see the government's efforts in helping the people.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Summarize the question.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, can the Minister give a comparison between Malaysia in overcoming this global energy crisis compared to regional countries
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and also developed countries.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Earlier the Minister said about reuse energy.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: So, can the government use this opportunity considering the T20, their subsidies will be abolished.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: We use this platform to encourage this T20 so that they use solar energy
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and we encourage them, incentives so that they can use solar energy.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Finally, it is often said that the IPP Contract is one of the reasons why they get a high profit margin reserve.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Will the government review the tariffs imposed by the IPP.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Mr President.
edus.speaker: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable City of Melaka.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For information, the announcement made by Yang Amat Berhormat Tambun after chairing MTEN informed that households who use electricity at a high amount will no longer receive subsidies from the government.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is after the implementation of the PADU or Main Database system which was also answered by the Prime Minister on May 22, during the PMQ session during the day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: For me, this is a matter of principle that we do not question.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If one house is T20, we assume five, six, seven air-conds, there are dryers with many other equipment
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and the electricity bill is RM500, RM600, RM700 or more, they should not be able to get more subsidies compared to the B40 or M40 groups.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Because it is based on consumption, then those who enjoy more subsidies in terms of ringgit compared to B40 and M40 users.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: In terms of principles it is not fair.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, to implement it
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: we need to have a PADU system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Now we only categorize domestic users according to consumption, the use of 300 kilowatts and below, 600 kilowatts to 300 kilowatt hours and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So he does not follow income.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, only with the PADU system which is expected to be completed at the end of the year, we will implement a targeted subsidy for T20 based on income.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Regarding what is mentioned for solar, we agree recently that I and Yang Berhormat Pandan have implemented an announcement about direction
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and also trade for renewable energy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have stated that out of the 40 percent renewable energy our target in 2050 before, we have increased to 70 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This can be implemented
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: when the energy price is more placed at the market price except for those who need to be protected.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, for that reason we will encourage this solar installation
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we also expect this to be massive solar installation throughout the country to be done.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If the price of solar can not compete with conventional electricity prices,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: this can not happen.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Finally, about the issue of IPP and reserve margin.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Among the problems that exist now, the government has JPPPET, which we plan electricity use for a period of 20 years, is done every year.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: My new JPPPET meeting earlier this year chaired the JPPPET meeting for 2022-2041.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: We have already placed when this power plant will end, when the power plant is new, whether it's gas, solar and so on when it will enter the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: `` 1040 Before there was an unsolicited IPP practice, any friend came, a company came, he gave to the Minister to do an IPP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: There is no in the government's planning but for certain reasons, the Cabinet approved the IPP grant.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Today we have a reserved margin between 40 to 50 percent access energy
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and we pay for this access energy through our electricity bills.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So for that reason, other countries can operate on 15 percent reserved margin
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: but we reach 40-50 percent.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: So, that's why we have made an announcement that we will stick to our announcement in each JPEG, there is no more unsolicited IPP.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If you come to us,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: please follow what is in the JPEG plan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: It is transparent, we can follow the plan
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: before we can control the excess electricity that is available and our desire even though it has not yet been implemented
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: if we can get early retirement of coal.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: This is one of the problems that contributes to pollution
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: and as obtained by Indonesia in the Just Energy Transition Partnership ( JETP ) their program.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: If we can do that, it has been touched upon by the Managing Director of Khazanah Nasional in a forum in Qatar recently,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: then we will get energy transition, a faster energy transition.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Tuan Khoo Poay Tiong [Kota Melaka]

edus.text: Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you for the answer of the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I would like to raise the issue of reserved margins mentioned earlier, a very large amount, 40 to 50 percent.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: I think we waste almost every time.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: My question is that we find that there is a request from neighboring countries to buy our energy whether Singapore or South Thailand.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Does the government not intend to look at this so that the reserved margins are not wasted
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: and we can generate income from this reserved margin, thank you.
edus.speaker: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]
addressees: Menteri Sumber Asli
Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kubang Kerian.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Indeed, we agree with that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: One of the best things for us to do is so that we can sell or trade the electricity in our country.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Therefore, the government under the leadership of His Excellency Tambun, we have reversed the band for us to trade Tenaga Boleh Baharu.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: So, this is a big decision
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: because for example I give an example of Singapore talking about making cables all the way to Australia, wanting to make cables all the way to Cambodia, wanting to make cables to Sarawak
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: while Johor is the closest location.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: So, today we can take advantage of it
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: when the government allows through energy exchange for us to sell the energy.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: [ Stands up ]
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: We are already selling conventional energy, YTL is selling to Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: That is already using our interconnect and there is also Singapore and Malaysia itself we have bought hydro energy from Laos through Thailand.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: It's just that what we need to do for us to really be the center of what one day ASEAN Power Grid says is that we have to upgrade or upgrade our inter-connection.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: We intend to allow the connection between Sarawak and the peninsula proposed
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: when the construction of the Bakun Dam can be realized.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: That's what I think is best for us.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Next, we get Thailand as well,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: it's true that they have a demand for electricity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: We have to upgrade our inter-connect,
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: so those steps need to be taken
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: so that we can become a hub for the ASEAN Power Grid.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Sumber Asli, Alam Sekitar dan Perubahan Iklim [Tuan Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad]
addressees: Dato' Sri Tuan Ibrahim bin Tuan Man [Kubang Kerian]

edus.text: Kota Belud is one more thing, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Puan Isnaraissah Munirah binti Majilis @ Fakharudy [Kota Belud]
addressees: Timbalan Yang di-Pertua [Puan Alice Lau Kiong Yieng]

edus.text: Good morning to the teachers and also the headmasters here, in this House. [ Applause ]
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin asked the Minister of Education to state whether the Ministry of Education will conduct a technical audit on the IDentity Management System ( idMe ), the Ministry of Education Integrated System ( MOEIS ) which often experiences technical disruptions that make it difficult for the duties of tens of thousands of teachers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: State the development expenses of this system and what action will be taken by the Ministry of Education against failed vendor companies?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Bismillahi Rahmani Rahim.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuh and good morning.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: everyone

edus.text: Thank you my friend Yang Berhormat Bayan Baru.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: For your information, the Malaysian Ministry of Education realizes that there is a access disruption to the Identity Management System ( idMe ) and the MoE Integrated System ( MOEIS ).
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The MoE detected the disruption starting on 19 January 2023 due to technical issues and system use issues.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The issue was resolved on 11 February 2023.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The system's performance continues to be monitored to ensure that it is always operating well to minimize access disruptions.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The MoE has identified the root of the problem to the entire system taking into account the overall system management as well as competency personnel to further strengthen the implementation of the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: As of 16 March 2023 Your Honor, a total of 89 percent of schools across the country have finished including data in the Integrated Assessment Management System under MOEIS through idMe.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: While the rest have the option to include data either through this management system or offline.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Despite being given the option, there are three states that use the Integrated Assessment Management System ( SPPB ) 100 percent, namely the states of Kelantan, Sarawak and the Federal Territory of Labuan.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: While the state of Perlis reached 99 percent of the filling into the system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: I would like to thank all the teachers who were patient
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: when this system was in a lawsuit, even giving full cooperation
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: when the MoE did a visit and was ready with the hybrid system,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: while we tried to improve the efficiency of this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: For your information, online classroom assessment involves several modules that are developed separately.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The modules are idME, MOEIS Institutional Modul, MOEIS Student Modul and SPPB.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: MOEIS is developed internally
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: while idMe and SPPB are developed in production to two different companies.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: These two systems are obtained in a quote and open tender in line with the Government Procurement Circular based on the ceiling price that has been set in the tender.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: For your information, the MoE will not compromise on any violation of the terms and conditions that have been set for the company that implements this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: For your information, the MoE is ready and open for any in-house technical inquiry and audit
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: if there are allegations regarding the violation of the procedure for the implementation of this system.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: That's it, thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you head teacher.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Earlier I asked the Honorable Minister to answer the cost of developing this project.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: That's the first question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: It's clear that this system failed and this is not new.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: There used to be many complaints from teachers out there.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: It should be focused on educating our children
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: but had to key in data until 4am.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: I think this is an injustice
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: and also torture to our teachers.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: So, I hope the ministry is firm in this regard.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: I hope and request that the Honorable Minister call the National Audit Department, look into whether there is any abuse of power or failures?
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Make sure that this new system is improved so
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: that our teachers can focus on learning our children.
edus.speaker: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
addressees: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]

edus.text: Thank you.

edus.speaker: Menteri Pendidikan [Puan Fadhlina binti Sidek]
addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Therefore, I mentioned earlier, Your Honor, among the quick actions we are making include providing a hybrid system

addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: Your Honor, I would also like to inform you that we will work with the Administrative Modernization and Management Planning Unit ( MAMPU ) for the implementation of technical audits in this system.

addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: The result of this audit is to improve the existing system in the planning of the upcoming MoE system.

addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]

edus.text: As I mentioned earlier, the MoE does not compromise with any or any relaxation of terms or any failure in the procedures that have been set in the company that implements this system.

addressees: Tuan Sim Tze Tzin [Bayan Baru]
