edus.text: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali asked the Minister of Health to state whether the ministry has made a decision to prohibit patients from using health clinic services closer to their homes after the re-delimitation of the constituency.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Kapar.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Mr. Speaker, the ministry is very committed to providing health services to all citizens.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: All health personnel at triages or registration counters are reminded not to reject any presence of any customer to seek treatment at a health clinic to meet the No Wrong Door Policy approach that has been implemented through personalized care or family doctor concept to ensure continuous health care
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: and can not be used as an excuse to reject customers who come from outside the health clinic cooperative area.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: For example, patients who receive treatment at health clinics in the Kapar Parliamentary area can seek treatment at nearby health clinics, for example in the Bukit Raja Parliamentary area
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: if the health clinic is close to the patient's residence for the comfort and convenience of the patient.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Good, Honorable Kapar.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Thank you Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, indeed that is the code of ethics for health.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: I want to give a setting– That is ideal.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: I want to mention the practical, where we get this complaint.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: When the third bridge of Klang was built by the Selangor State Government worth RM300 million, the Sungai Bertek Mother and Child Clinic which at that time was old needs to be demolished.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: At that time I was the assemblyman of the Klang Strait asking the government to replace not only pregnant and children but a more complete, comprehensive health center.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: When that has existed and when it is perfect, it can operate, I was asked by the clinic to tell the people of the Klang Strait, Sungai Udang, Kampung Delek, they don't know that this one exists,
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: it is already operating, you can come there, no need to go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Unfortunately, unfortunately what is happening now Mr. Speaker, their house after the redelineation of GE14, so the third bridge of Klang separates part of the former Klang Strait from the Klang Parliament.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: These people are separated from the health clinic from their house like from here to the Member of Parliament's Building.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: That's it, as close as that.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, they say they can't accept it, they are told ...
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: What is the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: ... go to Pandamaran Health Clinic.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Honorable Kapar, the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: So, I want to ask– When was the one earlier, open door policy, right?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Please let me know, this should be the policy already.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: So, why didn't that happen?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: The question is Honorable Kapar, the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: And maybe is there a reason
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Not enough what?
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Okay, that's the question?
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: So, I ask for the action of the Honorable Minister.
edus.speaker: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.text: Okay, thank you for the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Good, thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.text: Be patient, be patient.
edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]
addressees: Dr. Hajah Halimah Ali [Kapar]

edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

edus.speaker: Menteri Kesihatan [Dr. Zaliha binti Mustafa]

addressees: Dato’ Muhammad Bakhtiar bin Wan Chik [Balik Pulau]

edus.text: So, every medical practitioner including medical officers needs to take care of their ethics after we-

edus.text: We actually have a oath, we take a oath

edus.text: to amend the provisions of section 2 of the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998 [ Act 588 ] to ensure it is not misused.

edus.text: The Ministry of Communications and Digital and the Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission ( SKMM ) are currently studying the amendment to the Communications and Multimedia Act 1998, where the comprehensive approach will take into account all existing legal provisions also ensure that any punishment is effective and there is no element of persecution.

edus.text: The second is the Latex Production Incentive Rintis Project ( IPL ).

edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I would like to clarify here that issues related to Palestine have actually been brought to the ICC.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: For the information of the President, in accordance with the provisions in the Rome Statute, a criminal international case listed in the statute can only be referred to the ICC prosecutor by three parties,
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: whether it is a member of the Rome Statute itself, where Malaysia is not a member, the United Nations Security Council or the UN or with the ICC prosecutor's own initiative.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Palestine adopted the Rome Statute in 2015.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Following that, the ICC prosecutor had made an initial examination of the Palestinian situation whether the criteria of the Rome Statute were met to open any investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: In December 2019, the ICC prosecutor decided that the statutory criteria under the Rome Statute were met to open the investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Next, a pre-trial in the chamber was carried out in February 2021 to determine whether the ICC has jurisdiction over the Palestinian situation
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: because it involves legal issues and complex territories covering the Gaza Bank, the West Bank and Baitulmuqaddis.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: As a result of the pre-trial in the chamber, the ICC prosecutor announced in March 2021 to open an investigation into the Palestinian situation and alleged crimes committed by the Israeli side since June 13, 2014 without an end period.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Therefore, the Palestinian situation is already in the process of the ICC's investigation.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Malaysia will always call and cooperate with OIC member countries as well as countries as thought so that the UN can refer to the issue of Israeli cruelty not only to the ICC but to the International Court of Justice, with the permission of the International Court of Justice.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Every Prime Minister has their role but in the context of our Prime Minister, he takes further steps to be together with Muslim leaders around the world
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: including leaders from non-Muslim countries.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: I myself have done several efforts as Foreign Minister.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Speaking with the Secretary-General - Guterres
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and also with other leaders, dozens.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: Of those I contacted, whom I met, expressed my position so

edus.text: that this Palestinian problem can be resolved at an immediate rate.

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

edus.text: This war must be stopped at an immediate rate.

addressees: Tuan Haji Ahmad Fadhli bin Shaari [Pasir Mas]

everyone

addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

edus.text: and the bloc of Non-Aligned countries only issuing statements of motions and loud and vocal speeches
edus.speaker: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: but allowing the Palestinian people to be slaughtered by Zionist apartheid Israel?

addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

addressees: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: But, we can not take it lightly
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: because they are preparing to do it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: That's why Malaysia and including other countries in the OIC are working hard in these past few days to ensure that the matter is not done.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: A special conference that will be held

edus.text: and will be given space to every country that comes to convey their views, requesting that measures be expedited to stop any form of attack on Gaza.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: because Malaysia does its best.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: It is rather – with permission, it is rather unprecedented that in the context of Malaysia to go around the world.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: That's but we do that.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: We will continue our struggle to ensure that in the end, the Palestinian struggle for us to be able to solve together
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: and that Malaysia contributes the best in it.
edus.speaker: Menteri Luar Negeri [Datuk Seri Diraja Dr. Zambry bin Abd Kadir]
addressees: Tuan Hassan bin Abdul Karim [Pasir Gudang]

edus.text: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat asked the Minister of Transport to state the extent
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: to which the KTMB Shuttle Tebrau service ridership between JB Sentral and Woodlands, Singapore has recovered to a level before Covid-19.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Is the government willing to negotiate with Singapore to increase the service capacity from 36 bilateral trips to at least 50 trips to meet the people's demand?
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: For the information of the Honorable Member Pulai, the number of passengers of the Shuttle Tebrau service between JB Sentral and Woodlands, Singapore has recovered
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and even recorded a very encouraging increase.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: For the year 2023, the average passenger per day was 8,635 people, an increase of seven percent compared to the previous passenger record of COVID-19, which is a total of 8,077 people per day in 2019.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: The government has also held discussions with Singapore, through the Malaysia-Singapore Joint Ministerial Committee for Iskandar Malaysia platform
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: to increase the capacity of the Shuttle Tebrau service
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: which includes the increase in the frequency of train operations from 31 trips to 36 trips and the increase in the number of coaches per train operation from four coaches to eight coaches.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: This improvement will offer an increase in the capacity of the number of passengers up to 13,760 people per day.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Currently, Keretapi Tanah Melayu Berhad ( KTMB ) and the Ministry of Transport are still waiting for feedback from the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: ( ICA ), Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you to the Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: It has been more than 100 years of service.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, there have been many contributions there
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and many or many users are made up of workers who commute between Singapore and Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, it has been 100 years
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: and previously there have been many contributions.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Then it is also important for our position in Johor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: So, my question is whether KTMB Shuttle Tebrau will continue to operate,
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: after RTS will operate in 2027?
edus.speaker: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Please Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you to Yang Berhormat Pulai.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: First of all in the bilateral agreement between Malaysia and Singapore to implement the RTS project, one of the conditions that have already been agreed together is that when the RTS service is completed later
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and after the RTS starts operations,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: if I'm not mistaken six months after operating,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: then this Shuttle Tebrau service will be stopped.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: That was the previous agreement between Malaysia and Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: However, I understand that what Yang Berhormat Pulai has desired
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and I myself feel that it is not wrong
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: and if we have more connectivity between the two countries and this gives more choice to passengers.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: So, therefore the Ministry of Transport will work to negotiate this matter with Singapore so
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: that this service is maintained even after the RTS starts operating.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Suhaizan bin Kaiat [Pulai]

edus.text: Please Jerantut.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Thank you Tan Sri Yang di-Pertua.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Tuan Yang di-Pertua

edus.text: Thank you to the Minister for answering the question.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: A very good thing, refreshing
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: when the Minister tells about the increase in trains that will be added to avoid congestion during peak hours.
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: The question from us is what other initiatives or actions are being taken in collaboration between the Ministry of Transport, immigration, and the Johor State Government for us to reduce congestion during peak hours for our workers who work in Singapore?
edus.speaker: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Please, Minister.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.text: Thank you to Yang Berhormat Jerantut.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: First of all, in terms of the addition of the trip and the coach we do work on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, to realize this addition, it does not depend on one side only.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: On our part, especially the KTMB operator is ready.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We have enough coaches to increase that frequency
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: and also increase its capacity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, this is also subject to approval from Singapore who accept passengers
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: because they also have constraints in terms of their immigration in Woodlands.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: So, that's why the trip takes a long time for us to negotiate so that it can be added.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Both in terms of easing the congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Indeed, that is something that is very given attention by the government and a Special Cabinet Committee chaired by the Honorable Petra Jaya,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: also took various steps to reduce the congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We try to see various ways and coordination between various agencies to reduce the time required for us to cross the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Among the things I think that have already been taken into account and taken action.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: For example, in terms of the counter or Touch 'n Go touch point by paying the road charge for entry from Singapore has already been consolidated.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: So, the two counters are consolidated
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: and that of course can also save some time for cars from Singapore to enter Malaysia.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, there are many other ways.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We will try to add motorcycle lanes,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: also add counters and so on.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Also ensure that the immigration counters are always fully optimized.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: But, whatever we feel that the Johor Causeway is not easy for us to solve in terms of congestion and in terms of long-term time is that we expect that when the RTS project is completed,
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: it can disperse a little congestion in the Johor Causeway.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: We will also see various other ways to increase connectivity.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: For example, there is also a proposal to have ferry services between the two Malaysia and Singapore, especially from Johor Bahru to Singapore.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Thank you.
edus.speaker: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]
addressees: Tuan Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin [Jerantut]

edus.text: Good, Your Honor.
edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
addressees: Menteri Pengangkutan [Tuan Loke Siew Fook]

edus.speaker: Tuan Yang di-Pertua
